note: N-0110 Part B finding (Takealot one-week misread): the 'two months' in repair 2 are not a second period. Every Takealot file has ONE Transaction Week (the Monday) and a Transaction Month column. When the week crosses a month end, each product that sold on both sides appears twice in the same week, once per calendar month, each row holding that month's share (cip loads 1648 Jul 427 + Aug 28 = 455; 1650 Dec 111 + Jan 108; 1651 Mar 70 + Apr 115; 1652 Jun 102 + Jul 184; 1649 has no split). Barcode and stock repeat on both halves (28 of 28 products in both halves carry the same stock). The parser dates every row by Transaction Week (mapping Transaction Week -> period): 5 loads, 5 periods, grain week. The old 'last row wins' dropped one half; repair 2 sums the halves (Takealot 541 -> 1,253 units, which is every resolved staging unit of the 5 loads). No parser or period fix was needed; a test now pins the shape (test_cst_takealot_week_shape.py). Stored Takealot rows on cip are right for their week: 96 rows, 5 weeks, 100% of resolved units; 29 unresolved rows (30 units) in loads 1648, 1650, 1652 are product matches, not periods. Nothing was changed on cip.
